text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali instructed Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to boost cooperation in economy and trade exchanges with South Africa.
- South African Vice-President Thabo Mbeki to start on Wednesday a three-day official visit to Tunis.
- President Ben Ali on Monday received a report from Interior Minister Mohamed Ben Rejeb on the programme for road safety during the summer.

- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari received on Monday visiting Moroccan Foreign Affairs, Cooperation Secretary of State (junior minister) Tayeb Fassi Fihri. They discussed ways to reinforce bilateral cooperation. Fihri arrived in Tunis on Monday.
- Saudi Airlines expected to increase flights on Tunis route for summer holidays.
- Training and Employment Minister Moncer Rouissi said that small and medium firms create 40 percent of employment in the country.
- Tourism and Handicrafts Minister Slaheddine Maaoui is visiting Poland this week for talks on bilateral cooperation.
